description: The plot illustrates the MC1 scores of different models as a function of the number of demonstrations used, with the x-axis labeled "#Demonstrations" and spanning from 0 to 2000 on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 500, and the y-axis labeled "MC1" and ranging from 37 to 39 on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot contains three lines: a black line with square markers representing "Linear SAE", a blue dashed line representing "LLaMA-2-chat-7B", and a red dotted line representing "ICD (Prompt version)". The black "Linear SAE" line starts at approximately 37.2 at 0 demonstrations and increases to around 39.2 at 2000 demonstrations, showing a steady upward trend. The blue "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" line remains relatively stable, starting and ending at approximately 37.4. The red "ICD (Prompt version)" line is also relatively stable, starting and ending at around 37.4.
